```{r}


# Function to plot attention density over tokens
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

# Function to plot attention density over tokens
plot_attention_density <- function(df, row_idx = 1) {
  # Extract data for the specified row
  layer <- df$layer[row_idx]
  head <- df$head[row_idx]
  
  # Parse the attention_scores string into a numeric vector
  scores_str <- df$attention_scores[row_idx]
  # Remove newlines and convert spaces to commas for JSON parsing
  scores_str <- gsub("\n", "", scores_str)
  scores_str <- gsub(" ", ", ", scores_str)
  scores <- fromJSON(scores_str)
  
  # Parse the tokenized_passage string into a vector of tokens
  token_str <- df$tokenized_passage[row_idx]
  # Remove the brackets and split by comma+space, then clean quotes
  token_str <- gsub("^\\[|\\]$", "", token_str)  # Remove outer brackets
  tokens <- strsplit(token_str, ", ")[[1]]  # Split by comma+space
  tokens <- gsub("^'|'$", "", tokens)  # Remove surrounding quotes
  
  # Create a dataframe for plotting
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    token = tokens,
    position = 1:length(tokens),
    attention = scores[1:length(tokens)]
  )
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = position, y = 1, fill = attention)) +
    geom_tile(height = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "white", 
      mid = "lightblue", 
      high = "darkblue",
      midpoint = median(plot_df$attention),
      name = "Attention\nScore"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = plot_df$position,
      labels = plot_df$token
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Attention Scores - Layer", layer, "Head", head),
      x = "Tokens",
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Example usage:
# plot_attention_density(df_tmp, row_idx = 1)

# To plot multiple rows (e.g., different layers/heads):
plot_multiple_attention <- function(df, indices = 1:min(4, nrow(df))) {
  plots <- lapply(indices, function(i) {
    plot_attention_density(df, i)
  })
  
  # Combine plots using patchwork (if installed)
  if (require(patchwork)) {
    return(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1))
  } else {
    return(plots)  # Return list of plots
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)

plot_attention_density <- function(data, row_idx) {
  # Get the row
  row_data <- data[row_idx, ]
  
  # Parse tokenized_passage - it's in Python list format
  tokens_str <- row_data$tokenized_passage
  tokens_str <- gsub("^\\[|\\]$", "", tokens_str)  # Remove outer brackets
  
  # Split by comma, but only when outside quotes
  # Use a regex to match quoted strings
  tokens <- regmatches(tokens_str, gregexpr("'[^']*'", tokens_str))[[1]]
  tokens <- gsub("'", "", tokens)  # Remove the quotes
  
  # Clean tokens - remove 'Ġ' symbol (represents space in tokenizers)
  tokens <- gsub("Ġ", "", tokens)
  
  # Parse attention_scores - convert directly to numeric
  scores_str <- row_data$attention_scores
  scores_str <- gsub("^\\[|\\]$", "", scores_str)  # Remove outer brackets
  scores <- as.numeric(strsplit(trimws(scores_str), "\\s+")[[1]])
  
  # Debug: print lengths to verify they match
  cat("Number of tokens:", length(tokens), "\n")
  cat("Number of scores:", length(scores), "\n")
  
  # Handle length mismatch
  min_len <- min(length(tokens), length(scores))
  if (length(tokens) != length(scores)) {
    warning(paste("Length mismatch! Tokens:", length(tokens), 
                  "Scores:", length(scores), 
                  "Using first", min_len, "elements"))
    tokens <- tokens[1:min_len]
    scores <- scores[1:min_len]
  }
  
  # Create dataframe for plotting
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    token = tokens,
    position = 1:length(tokens),
    attention = scores
  )
  
  # Extract model, layer, and head info
  model_name <- row_data$model_shorthand
  layer <- row_data$layer
  head <- row_data$head
  
  # Create heatmap
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = position, y = 1, fill = attention)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:length(tokens), labels = tokens) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(model_name, " - Layer ", layer, ", Head ", head),
      x = "Tokens",
      y = "",
      fill = "Attention"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Use it:
plot_attention_density(olmo_data_step0, row_idx = 100)
```
